items.title: Lumentum Sinks 11% in a Week as Marvell’s All-Stock Offer Shrinks: “Our Demand Couldn’t Be Stronger”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 11% in the past week as the AI hardware selloff hit Marvell, whose all-stock offer drives its price, and it lagged Coherent’s rebound. September-quarter revenue rose 136.

items.title: Can Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Stay Reasonable If Cash Flow Delivers?
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings has been on an eye catching multi year run, and with an agreed all stock acquisition by Marvell now in play, the real question for you is whether the current share price is still grounded in the cash flows the business can produce. Over the past 3 years, Lumentum has delivered a very large share price gain of about 13x, which puts a lot of expectations on the cash the company can generate in the future. items.title: “The Next Trillion Dollar Company”: Marvell Is Up 82% in 2026. Take Profits, or Buy More?
